texts.zh: 使用隐身[GetIndividualNamePlural]和牵引光束，我们能够成功地收集、分析和研究毫无防备的[pre_ftl_species.GetName]个体，之后再将其送还到自己的居所。不幸的是，牵引光束对于[pre_ftl_species.GetAdj]的生理机能产生了预料之外的效果。在返回家中以后，这些样品开始遭受疖子、疹子以及不受控制地打喷嚏，在回到家中的三个小时之后其外表皮还会发生溶解。这种神秘的溶肤病已经酿成了全国范围内的卫健紧急事件，而验尸报告毫无疑问会揭示外部干预的证据。
texts.en: Using stealthy [GetIndividualNamePlural] and tractor beams, we were able to successfully collect, analyze and study unsuspecting [pre_ftl_species.GetName] individuals and return them to their dwellings. Unfortunately, the tractor beams had an unexpected effect on the [pre_ftl_species.GetAdj] physiology. After being returned to their homes, the specimens started suffering from boils, rashes and uncontrollable sneezing, experiencing a total dissolution of their outer tissue layers within three hours from their return. The mysterious skin-dissolving illness has already become a national health emergency, and autopsies will doubtlessly reveal proof of external tampering.

# 医疗副作用 / Medical Side Effects

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:4705-4814`；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-201（每月观测事件池）；`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:316-376`（preftl.50）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 被观测的前超光速文明的“科技进步”局势每月有 5/100 的机会运行 preftl.50（之后 1800 天冷却），从每月观测事件池中按权重抽取一个条件满足的事件；本事件权重 50。
  The observed pre-FTL civilization's tech-progress situation has a 5/100 monthly chance to run preftl.50 (then an 1800-day cooldown), which draws one valid event from the monthly observation pool by weight; this event has weight 50.
- 条件：以“样本采集”任务观测（任何时代）；观测国不是岩石生命或机械帝国——注：此处 owner 指被观测的文明；每个前超光速文明一次。
  Conditions: observed with Specimen Collection (any age); the observed civilization (the dispatcher's owner) is not a lithoid or machine empire; once per pre-FTL civilization.
- 隐藏分派事件设置一次性标记，然后在 0–25 天后向观测哨站拥有者（及游牧中继站观察者）发出可见事件。
  The hidden dispatcher sets a once-only flag and sends the visible event to the observation post owner (and nomad waystation observers) after 0-25 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 2001「医疗副作用」：我们的牵引光束对被抓取研究的个体产生了意外的生理影响。
  2001 "Medical Side Effects": our tractor beams had unexpected physiological effects on the abducted specimens.
- 选项：再次绑架以研究效果；降低功率、暂避风头；提高功率并在原住民身上测试。单页事件。
  Options: re-abduct them to study the effects; lower the beam power and lie low; increase the power and test it on the natives. A single window.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 这是随机观测插曲：只在满足条件时可能出现，彼此之间没有固定顺序。
  This is a random observation interlude: it may appear only when its conditions hold, with no fixed order relative to other interludes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无额外的文明差异分支。
  No further empire-specific variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发与三个选项。
  Checked: trigger and the three options.
